briefTitle: First-in-human Study of Interferon-y PET Imaging to Assess Response to Immunotherapy

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: FDG PET done within 2 months of the baseline imaging, as part of standard-of-care.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Baseline imaging window and standard of care imaging requirement is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 with at least one lesion of at least 2 cm in a region of the body that can be imaged by PET (e.g.,outside of the liver)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.
